headline: Lockheed Martin is Down 8% in 6 Months: Wall Street Pro Expects 30% Growth Within a Year
summary: Lockheed Martin just delivered a blowout quarter with a record-breaking backlog, yet the stock sits near a six-month low while one Wall Street analyst sees nearly 30% upside. The real question is whether a single ugly quarter buried a defense giant or exposed something deeper.

headline: Boeing's Finished Flight Test Counts Most For A Different Jet
summary: Monday's approval was already telegraphed, the rare double upgrade beside it was not, and the finished flight test frees engineering capacity for a different program entirely.

headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on General Dynamics, Raises Price Target to $440
summary: Wells Fargo  analyst David Strauss   maintains General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $400 to $440.
